description: This Java source file defines the class RecurringDepositTransactionWorkbookPopulator, which extends AbstractWorkbookPopulator. It is responsible for creating and populating an Excel workbook sheet that handles recurring deposit transaction data import, including setting up sheet layout, data validation rules, default formulas, and populating tables with savings account data.

classes.name: RecurringDepositTransactionWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class responsible for populating an Excel workbook sheet with recurring deposit transaction data, including layout setup, data validation, default formulas, and data population for savings accounts.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method that creates and populates the recurring deposit transaction sheet in the provided workbook.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default formulas for product and opening balance columns for rows in the worksheet.

methods.name: setTextFormatStyle
methods.description: Applies text format style to specified columns in the worksheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for various columns in the worksheet, including lists and date constraints.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Creates named ranges in the workbook for dropdowns and lookup formulas used in data validation.

methods.name: populateSavingsTable
methods.description: Populates the savings account data into the worksheet, including client name, account number, product, and activation date.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the sheet layout, including column widths and header labels.
